Trial Balance

The Trial Balance report lists all general ledger accounts with their debit and credit balances as of a specific date.

This fundamental accounting report verifies that total debits equal total credits, confirming the books are in balance.

Use the trial balance to review account balances, detect errors, and prepare financial statements.

Configure the report date and display options to show zero-balance accounts or filter by account groups.

Title

Enter a custom title for the report, or leave blank to use the default title.

Description

Add an optional description or subtitle that will appear under the report title.

Accounting method

Select whether to use accrual or cash basis accounting for this report.

Periods

Add one or more periods to compare account balances across different time frames.

Show account codes

Check to display account codes alongside account names in the report.

Exclude zero balances

Check to exclude accounts with zero balances from the report.
